Tail-integral identities establish the conditional moment threshold and truncated-second logarithmic coefficient. A decreasing polynomial in squared loss gives exactly one tail coefficient maximizer and a direct integral derivative gives the competing total-absorption sign. A standalone finite checker passed 66 corroborating identities and Bessel evaluations; no finite experiment substitutes for the analytic proof.
